blind.description: A stylized wooden merchant counter with recessed panel detailing on the sides. The right side of the counter top is bare wood, while the left side is stacked with tailoring supplies: multiple colorful fabric bolts and rolls (dark green, red, golden yellow, beige), neatly folded stacks of colored cloth, two small spools of thread, and a wooden hat stand displaying a wide-brimmed reddish-brown fedora. Surfaces are clean, solid, and fully textured in a hand-painted fantasy RPG style.
blind.from_above: A rectangular brown tabletop where the right portion is bare wood, and the left portion is covered by parallel cylindrical fabric rolls, folded rectangular cloth layers, and a round brimmed hat with a creased crown.
blind.height_vs_figure: The counter table stands about half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 3 ft tall), with the fabric rolls and hat reaching to about two-thirds height (~4 ft); length is roughly equal to the figure's height (5 to 6 ft).
